$comment: Spec R6/D4: coverage is judged against the fields that existed when the game was played, not against a single uniform field list. Otherwise a 2015 game is `partial` because void grubs were not invented yet, and a marker that fires on every row cannot catch the one row it exists for. An era is a contiguous window; a field that did not exist inside the window is ineligible and is excluded from the coverage computation. Eras are contiguous on purpose, so a field that was temporarily removed (the Chemtech Drake) is expressed by an era that omits it, with no extra mechanism. `cites` records where the boundary comes from: every date here was read off the League of Legends wiki's own patch page for the version named, not inferred from this dataset.

team-stats.cites: The dataset's declared era floor (spec objective): 2011. Before the Rift Herald, a team-stat row is kills, gold, towers, inhibitors, barons and a plain dragon count.
V5.22, released 2015-11-11 (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/V5.22): the Rift Herald enters the Baron pit.
V6.1, released 2016-01-14 (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/V6.1): drakes become elemental (Cloud, Infernal, Mountain, Ocean) and the Elder Dragon appears.
V11.23, released 2021-11-18 (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/V11.23): the Hextech and Chemtech Drakes join the elemental set.
V12.2, released 2022-01-19: the Chemtech Drake is withdrawn from the Rift, so a value for it cannot exist for games in this window.
V12.22, released 2022-11-16 (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/V12.22): the Chemtech Drake returns in a reworked form.
V14.1, released 2024-01-10 (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/V14.1): Voidgrubs spawn in the top-side jungle.
V25.S1.1, released 2025-01-09 (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/V25.S1.1): Atakhan joins the epic monsters.
